verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm. Its evidenced offerings are legal services plus free self-service web resources: Tech Studio forms, document generators and articles, Orrick Labs legal tech, and Orrick Connect client portals. Developer SDKs are outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Orrick ships any SDK, API or developer tooling that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
